roll_call: I trained in exact science, but I will not ignore the hunger of the mind.
I did not bring home conclusions alone. I also brought seeds meant to grow in the future.
I chose the homeland of my dreams over the more convenient country. Now I will record that choice.
deploy: Look first at the natural shape revealed by the records. I will not alter it carelessly.
Do not hurry to imitate the new. Repair the water and sewer systems first.
Do not line up houses like soldiers. A city's beauty can come from their different forms.
battle_win: Honest testing left us evidence. Verification must come before fashion.
If the present may be written as it is, then the past may be written as it was.
I observed calmly instead of decorating the record with emotion. That contemplation preserved it.
battle_draw: In protecting the natural shape of history, I became bound by history. I will loosen that knot slowly.
One should answer the demands of the day and know what is enough. I have not yet reached that state.
I can see the riddle. I no longer need to rush to solve it at once.
battle_lose: There is still no air in which the new seeds can grow. I will not discard the seeds themselves.
Position and circumstance drove me from the laboratory. Natural science, now I bid you farewell.
I remain a man who cannot be satisfied. If I am lost, I will record that fact first.
clash_attack: Do not discard and arrange facts at will. I will not alter history for a novel's convenience.
I will not follow something merely because it is Western. Show me the evidence of direct testing.
Death is the grave event that cuts everything off. Let no one intrude upon my wishes at that moment.
